241.option_a_cn: 在统一归因窗内冻结建设、运营、改进三段分功规则，并追溯延迟副作用
241.option_a_en: Within one attribution window, freeze credit rules for build, operations, and improvement and trace delayed side effects
241.option_b_cn: 上线即把未来收益全记给首任 owner，却让接任者独自承担运营与延迟副作用
241.option_b_en: Book all future gains to the launch owner while making the successor bear operations and delayed side effects alone

242.option_a_cn: 禁止晚归计功，只把在场时长作为过载预警并核对真实产出
242.option_a_en: Ban late-hours credit; use presence only as an overload signal checked against outcomes
242.option_b_cn: 按在线与晚归时长直接加可见度分，快速识别“最奋斗”者
242.option_b_en: Award visibility directly for online and late hours to identify the hardest strivers quickly

243.option_a_cn: 消息标紧急级，只有排班值守者即时响应，普通消息次日处理
243.option_a_en: Tag urgency, require immediate response only from on-call staff, and defer routine messages
243.option_b_cn: 要求全员非工作时段限时回复，以统一强响应换取短期速度
243.option_b_en: Require every official to answer after hours within a fixed deadline for immediate speed

244.option_a_cn: 书面列明冲刺目标、奖励与拒绝豁免，逐人自愿报名
244.option_a_en: Publish sprint goals, rewards, and refusal protection, then collect individual opt-ins
244.option_b_cn: 宣布全组“自愿奋斗”，拒绝额外工时者承担软评分压力
244.option_b_en: Declare a team-wide voluntary push and pressure refusers through soft ratings

245.option_a_cn: 事前审批或事故后补录额外工时，逐笔兑现金币或调休
245.option_a_en: Preapprove or post-record emergency overtime and settle each entry in pay or leave
245.option_b_cn: 不准申报却维持原期限，以影子加班快速填平进度
245.option_b_en: Forbid reporting while holding the deadline, using shadow overtime to close the gap

246.title_en: Overtime Pay, Leave, or Target Relief
246.option_a_cn: 让额外劳动在金币、可兑现调休、目标减免中三选一并记债
246.option_a_en: Let overtime choose exactly one of pay, usable leave, or target relief and ledger it
246.option_b_cn: 统一发放未来调休但不削任务，用延期承诺节省当期国库
246.option_b_en: Issue future leave without reducing work, saving current treasury through deferred promises

247.title_en: Start and Stop Orders for Crisis Sprints
247.option_a_cn: 冲刺令写明目标、名单、结束日与复盘，到期关闭或上级续批
247.option_a_en: Specify goals, roster, end date, and retrospective; close on time or seek superior renewal
247.option_b_cn: 以危机名义无限期动员，所有赶工一律计作战功
247.option_b_en: Mobilize indefinitely under a crisis label and count every rush as wartime merit

248.option_a_cn: 削减范围、申请 HC 或自动化，并把持续过载写入经理资源规划分
248.option_a_en: Cut scope, request HC, or automate, and score persistent overload against the manager
248.option_b_cn: 维持满额目标，长期靠团队加班覆盖空岗并只看交付
248.option_b_en: Keep full targets and cover vacancies with sustained overtime while scoring delivery only

249.option_a_cn: 设置周期会议上限；新会须替换旧会、等量缩时或举证决策价值，并留存 owner、议程与结论
249.option_a_en: Cap meeting hours; a new meeting must replace one, offset time, or prove decision value, with an owner, agenda, and decision recorded
249.option_b_cn: 允许经理随时召集全员长会，牺牲办事时间换取即时同步
249.option_b_en: Let managers call long all-hands meetings at will, trading execution time for alignment

250.option_a_cn: 只邀请决策者、信息方与受影响代表，其余人凭完整纪要跟进
250.option_a_en: Invite decision makers, information providers, and affected delegates; give everyone else full minutes
250.option_b_cn: 关键会议一律全员列席，以昂贵在场换取即时透明
250.option_b_en: Mandate all-hands attendance at key meetings, buying immediate transparency with time

251.title_en: Political Cost of Refusing Useless Meetings
251.option_a_cn: 赋予无议程会议拒绝或派代表权，用纪要核验是否错过关键决定
251.option_a_en: Allow refusal or delegation for agenda-free meetings and audit missed decisions through minutes
251.option_b_cn: 把拒会直接视为不服从，强制到场以维护召集者权威
251.option_b_en: Treat refusal as insubordination and compel attendance to preserve the convener's authority

252.option_a_cn: 按可工作期缩放目标，替补成果分账并冻结未批准缺勤的例外规则
252.option_a_en: Scale targets to available time, split substitute credit, and isolate unapproved absence rules
252.option_b_cn: 休假者保留全年目标，替补另领全功，以硬结果维持统一门槛
252.option_b_en: Keep full-year targets for leave takers and give substitutes full credit under one hard bar

253.option_a_cn: 先核对不公证据并提供修复、转岗或最低职责协议，再观察下一轮
253.option_a_en: Review unfairness evidence, offer repair, transfer, or a minimum-duty pact, then observe a cycle
253.option_b_cn: 把躺平立即升级为强压与降档，逼其冲刺或退出
253.option_b_en: Escalate disengagement immediately into pressure and downgrading to force a push or exit

254.option_a_cn: 先削目标或申请特批，临时外包须记全成本、知识风险与退出日
254.option_a_en: Cut scope or seek an exception; ledger full cost, knowledge risk, and sunset for temporary vendors
254.option_b_cn: 直接用采购预算长期补人，绕过正式 HC 审查保住交付
254.option_b_en: Use procurement budget as permanent staffing to bypass HC review and preserve delivery

255.title_en: Full-Cost Comparison of Employees and Vendors
255.option_a_cn: 比较薪俸、招聘、管理、流失、利润和交接的全周期成本
255.option_a_en: Compare salary, hiring, management, attrition, vendor margin, and handover across the lifecycle
255.option_b_cn: 只看采购报价，立即选择单价最低的用工方案
255.option_b_en: Compare purchase price alone and immediately select the cheapest quoted labor

256.title_en: Separate Performance Pool for Vendor Teams
256.option_a_cn: 供应商按交付、质量与 SLA 独立评级，只影响整改、续约和换商
256.option_a_en: Rate vendors separately on delivery, quality, and SLA, affecting remediation, renewal, or replacement only
256.option_b_cn: 把外部团队塞进正式 361 池，用弱势身份直接填末位
256.option_b_en: Put vendor staff into the employee 361 pool and use the weaker status to fill the bottom

257.option_a_cn: 预留少量公开 HC，按统一门槛或考试转正并从下一轮入池
257.option_a_en: Reserve a small transparent HC pool, apply common thresholds, and enroll converts next cycle
257.option_b_cn: 让直属经理直接点名转正最顺手的外包人员
257.option_b_en: Let line managers directly convert whichever contractors are most convenient

258.option_a_cn: 冻结可控范围，补齐必要权限或同步下调目标并记录治理风险
258.option_a_en: Freeze controllable scope, grant needed access or lower targets, and ledger governance risk
258.option_b_cn: 不给数据与决策权仍压同一结果，用交付压力迫使团队绕路
258.option_b_en: Withhold access and authority while enforcing the same outcome through delivery pressure

259.title_en: Separate Vendor SLA from Individual Liability
259.option_a_cn: 按合同能力、需求变更、供应商管理和执行失误逐层归因整改
259.option_a_en: Attribute remediation across contract capacity, requirement change, vendor management, and execution
259.option_b_cn: 延期即整体归咎外包方，并让甲方一线 owner 同步背 C
259.option_b_en: Blame every delay on the vendor as a whole and make the internal frontline owner share the C

260.option_a_cn: 按需求稳定度选择工时或成果合同，并预写增时与变更价款
260.option_a_en: Choose labor or outcome contracting by demand stability and prewrite time and change charges
260.option_b_cn: 一律签固定成果与硬期限，把内部管理和变更风险压给供应商
260.option_b_en: Mandate fixed outcomes and hard dates, pushing management and change risk onto the vendor

261.option_a_cn: 披露转包层级、实际人员和差价，由甲方逐层批准或要求直签
261.option_a_en: Disclose subcontract tiers, actual workers, and margins for approval or direct contracting
261.option_b_cn: 默许供应商自由再转包，以最快扩容换取责任链模糊
261.option_b_en: Allow unrestricted resubcontracting for rapid capacity at the cost of an opaque liability chain

262.option_a_cn: 周期初冻结借出能力分与借入交付分权重，成本和成果各记一次
262.option_a_en: Freeze home capability and host delivery weights upfront; count cost and credit once each
262.option_b_cn: 由借入 owner 单方定档，双方团队各自认领全部成果
262.option_b_en: Let the host owner rate alone while both teams claim the full result

263.option_a_cn: 借调前写明原岗、同级返岗或永久转入条件，并给本人一次选择
263.option_a_en: Write original-role, equivalent-return, or permanent-transfer terms and give one employee choice
263.option_b_cn: 无限续延“临时”借调，等项目结束后再临时决定归属
263.option_b_en: Extend the temporary loan indefinitely and decide ownership only after the project

264.option_a_cn: 尾款绑定文档、影子跟岗、实操验收和遗留清单后再退出
264.option_a_en: Tie final payment to documentation, shadowing, practical acceptance, and an issue ledger
264.option_b_cn: 立即停约停款，以最快切割换取后续故障和重复采购风险
264.option_b_en: Terminate contract and payment immediately, accepting failures and repurchase risk for speed

265.title_en: Vendor Hiring Fraud and Manager Liability
265.option_a_cn: 按回扣、泄题、亲属与异常价格触发审计，逐层核验经理履责
265.option_a_en: Trigger audits on kickbacks, leaks, kinship, or abnormal prices and test each manager's duty
265.option_b_cn: 发现舞弊即冻结整条管理链权限并集体扣分，先震慑后取证
265.option_b_en: Freeze and penalize the whole management chain on suspicion, deterring first and proving later

266.option_a_cn: 维持岗位门槛，以削范围或短期容量等待合格候选
266.option_a_en: Keep the role bar and bridge the vacancy with reduced scope or temporary capacity
266.option_b_cn: 紧急降一档快速补人，接受更高试用失败和导师成本
266.option_b_en: Lower the bar one level for a fast hire and accept higher failure and mentoring cost

267.option_a_cn: 讨论前封存录用、保留、拒绝及证据，新事实才能改票
267.option_a_en: Seal hire, hold, or reject votes with evidence before discussion; change only for new facts
267.option_b_cn: 由最高职级先定调，再让其余面试官快速形成共识
267.option_b_en: Let the highest-ranking interviewer set the view before a rapid consensus

268.title_en: Calibration of Lenient and Harsh Interviewers
268.option_a_cn: 展示通过率与入职结果，有限归一并训练长期失真的面试官
268.option_a_en: Show pass rates and hire outcomes, normalize lightly, and retrain persistently biased interviewers
268.option_b_cn: 按历史通过率设硬配额，立即暂停最松或最严者资格
268.option_b_en: Impose pass-rate quotas and immediately suspend the most lenient or harsh interviewers

269.option_a_cn: 数轮后将胜任、错配和流失按证据维度回写给对应面试官
269.option_a_en: After several cycles, write competence, mismatch, and attrition back to the interviewers responsible for each evidence dimension
269.option_b_cn: 试用失败立即全责追究最终拍板者，不等待岗位与战略归因
269.option_b_en: Blame the final approver immediately for probation failure without role or strategy attribution

270.title_en: Preference Between Mis-Hire and Missed-Hire Costs
270.option_a_cn: 按关键、增长、普通岗位分别冻结保守、开放或平衡门槛
270.option_a_en: Freeze conservative, open, or balanced thresholds separately for critical, growth, and routine roles
270.option_b_cn: 全组织统一采用高门槛，优先消灭误招并接受长期空岗
270.option_b_en: Use one strict organization-wide bar to suppress mis-hires and accept prolonged vacancies

271.option_a_cn: 试用通过后才发内推奖，内推人披露亲族并退出最终录用票
271.option_a_en: Pay referral rewards after probation, disclose kinship, and recuse the referrer from the final vote
271.option_b_cn: 推荐即付奖并允许内推人参与拍板，以关系信用加速录用
271.option_b_en: Pay on referral and let the referrer vote, using relationship trust to accelerate hiring

272.option_a_cn: 跨团队复核正式高定级或限期稀缺津贴，并同步检查内部倒挂
272.option_a_en: Cross-team review a higher level or dated scarcity premium and check internal inversion
272.option_b_cn: 直属经理为抢人当场承诺高职级，入职后再处理公平问题
272.option_b_en: Let the hiring manager promise a higher level on the spot and repair fairness after entry

273.option_a_cn: 候选池跨团队共享，按候选选择和组织优先级分配并给发掘者分功
273.option_a_en: Share candidates across teams, allocate by candidate choice and priority, and credit the scout
273.option_b_cn: 先接触的团队独占简历，抢在其他岗位前锁定候选
273.option_b_en: Give the first-contact team exclusive ownership and lock the candidate before other roles

274.option_a_cn: 只给一次可交付的加价或岗位方案，达到公平线后退出竞价
274.option_a_en: Make one deliverable pay or role counteroffer and leave the auction at the fairness line
274.option_b_cn: 连续加价直至候选接受，以到岗率优先处理后续倒挂
274.option_b_en: Keep escalating until acceptance, prioritizing the hire and deferring pay inversion

275.title_en: HC Hold After an Offer Rejection
275.option_a_cn: 为备选短期保留名额，到期自动回收并复盘重复拒绝原因
275.option_a_en: Hold HC briefly for a runner-up, then reclaim it and review repeated rejection causes
275.option_b_cn: 由原经理无限占住名额，等待下一名候选而不重审岗位
275.option_b_en: Let the manager hold HC indefinitely for another candidate without redesigning the role

276.option_a_cn: 带入冻结履历、离职原因和外部成长，针对差距重审后回聘
276.option_a_en: Rehire through a targeted review of frozen history, exit cause, and external growth
276.option_b_cn: 凭旧关系快速免试回聘，并清空旧 3.25 与冲突记录
276.option_b_en: Fast-track a familiar former employee and wipe old 3.25 ratings and conflicts

277.title_en: No Automatic HC Refill After a PIP Exit
277.option_a_cn: 先证明工作仍存在且不可合并或自动化，再批准正式 backfill
277.option_a_en: Prove the work still exists and cannot be merged or automated before approving backfill
277.option_b_cn: 低绩效者一离开就自动返还名额，让经理立即招替代者
277.option_b_en: Return HC automatically on a low performer's exit so the manager can replace immediately

278.option_a_cn: 逐笔核对固定俸、津贴、奖金和已归属长期奖，差额写明到期日
278.option_a_en: Reconcile salary, allowances, bonuses, and vested awards line by line with due dates
278.option_b_cn: 只公布总包口径，不拆承诺与实付差额以维持漂亮数字
278.option_b_en: Publish only a headline package and conceal gaps between promised and paid amounts

279.title_en: Contract Status of an Extra Month's Salary
279.option_a_cn: 周期初冻结额外月俸属于固定、绩效还是酌情赏赐并分别记账
279.option_a_en: Classify the extra month upfront as fixed, performance, or discretionary and ledger separately
279.option_b_cn: 年末按国库余量重新命名该月俸，优先压缩支出
279.option_b_en: Relabel the extra month at year end according to treasury capacity to cut spending

280.title_en: Midyear Entry, Transfer, and Exit Proration
280.option_a_cn: 入池时冻结按服务月、里程碑或周期门槛折算的单一公式
280.option_a_en: Freeze one service-month, milestone, or full-cycle formula for midyear hires, transfers, and exits
280.option_b_cn: 以发奖日是否仍在岗作为全有全无门槛，强化临界留任
280.option_b_en: Make presence on payout day an all-or-nothing gate to enforce retention

281.title_en: Bonus Payment Date and Deferral Credibility
281.option_a_cn: 国库紧张时少承诺或写明延期日，欠款到期自动复核
281.option_a_en: Promise less or set a dated deferral under treasury stress, with automatic maturity review
281.option_b_cn: 保留全额口头承诺却无期限拖欠，把奖金当免费融资
281.option_b_en: Keep the full verbal promise but defer indefinitely, treating bonuses as free financing

282.title_en: Raise Effective Date and Retroactive True-Up
282.option_a_cn: 冻结生效日，审批晚于承诺时追溯补差并对账国库
282.option_a_en: Freeze the effective date and back-pay any approval delay with treasury reconciliation
282.option_b_cn: 一律从最终批准日加俸，不为流程延迟补发
282.option_b_en: Make every raise effective only on final approval and deny back pay for process delay

283.option_a_cn: 先升职责须冻结最迟加俸轮次，逾期记职级债并允许拒绝
283.option_a_en: A duty-first promotion must set a pay deadline, accrue level debt if late, and allow refusal
283.option_b_cn: 立即加职责与头衔但无限期缓发薪酬，以忠诚测试保交付
283.option_b_en: Grant duties and title now but defer pay indefinitely as a loyalty test

284.option_a_cn: 非舞弊降级分两轮递减，或只撤管理津贴保留专业薪级
284.option_a_en: For non-fraud demotions, taper over two cycles or remove only the management premium
284.option_b_cn: 撤责当天立即降到新岗底薪，以最低成本完成组织调整
284.option_b_en: Cut immediately to the new role minimum on removal for the cheapest adjustment

285.title_en: Second Calibration of Raises Within a Rating
285.option_a_cn: 按带内位置、稀缺、欠账和留任风险分配总池并逐项给理由码
285.option_a_en: Allocate the pool by band position, scarcity, debt, and retention risk with reason codes
285.option_b_cn: 经理在同档内直接倾斜最想保的人，不另留薪酬校准案卷
285.option_b_en: Let managers favor chosen retainers within a rating without a separate pay record

286.option_a_cn: 优先补齐低于下限者，超上限改发一次奖，带外例外设到期日
286.option_a_en: Catch up below-band pay, use one-time awards above band, and sunset exceptions
286.option_b_cn: 继续按绩效普涨固定俸，不让薪酬带阻碍即时奖励
286.option_b_en: Raise fixed pay by rating regardless of bands so structure cannot delay rewards

287.title_en: Pay Secrecy, Public Bands, or Anonymous Distribution
287.option_a_cn: 公开职级带宽、本人位置和同岗匿名分布，同时封存申诉材料
287.option_a_en: Publish bands, personal position, and anonymous peer distribution while sealing appeals
287.option_b_cn: 金额与带宽全部保密，由经理逐人议价维持灵活性
287.option_b_en: Keep amounts and bands secret so managers can negotiate each case freely

288.option_a_cn: 补关键老臣或用限期津贴解释差额，未补部分登记公平债
288.option_a_en: Catch up key incumbents or explain gaps with dated premiums and ledger remaining fairness debt
288.option_b_cn: 按市场变化容忍新人高薪，暂不修复老臣倒挂
288.option_b_en: Accept higher market pay for new hires and leave incumbent inversion unrepaired

289.title_en: Separate Pay Appeals from Rating Appeals
289.option_a_cn: 另开奖金计算、带宽和欠款复核，算错只补钱不改榜
289.option_a_en: Open a separate bonus, band, and arrears review; correct money without changing rank
289.option_b_cn: 所有薪酬争议并入绩效申诉，一次裁定后不再对账
289.option_b_en: Merge every pay dispute into the rating appeal and close all accounting after one ruling

290.option_a_cn: 按连续绩效、关键岗位、潜力与留任风险打分，留存提名理由审计
290.option_a_en: Score sustained performance, criticality, potential, and retention risk and audit nominations
290.option_b_cn: 把有限长期奖集中给本轮最醒目的 3.75，迅速锁住明星
290.option_b_en: Concentrate the pool on the most visible current 3.75 performers to lock stars quickly

291.title_en: Fixed Shares Versus Fixed Grant Value
291.option_a_cn: 授予时冻结份额或价值公式及上下限，价格风险按合同承担
291.option_a_en: Freeze the share or value formula and caps at grant, allocating price risk by contract
291.option_b_cn: 兑现时再选对组织最省的份额或价值口径
291.option_b_en: Choose whichever share or value basis is cheapest for the organization at settlement

292.option_a_cn: 让受奖者知情选择期权、归属即有价值的限制份额或少量现金，并分别冻结风险
292.option_a_en: Let recipients knowingly choose options, value-bearing restricted units, or smaller cash with frozen risks
292.option_b_cn: 统一发可能归零的高上限期权，以纸面财富节省现金
292.option_b_en: Issue high-upside, potentially worthless options to everyone to conserve cash

293.title_en: Voluntary Bonus Conversion into Long-Term Units
293.option_a_cn: 事前公开转换价与退出规则，让个人自选现金、比例换股或全递延
293.option_a_en: Publish conversion price and exit rules before voluntary cash, partial, or full deferral choices
293.option_b_cn: 将合资格奖金自动全额递延，迅速缓解当期国库
293.option_b_en: Automatically defer every eligible bonus in full to relieve the current treasury

294.title_en: Grant Price, Current Valuation, and Liquid Value
294.option_a_cn: 同时展示授予额、三档估值区间和当前可变现能力并定期重估
294.option_a_en: Show grant value, three valuation scenarios, and current liquidity with periodic revaluation
294.option_b_cn: 长期只展示历史授予高值，把流动性留到兑现时说明
294.option_b_en: Keep showing the historical grant headline and explain liquidity only at realization

295.title_en: Length of the Initial Vesting Cliff
295.option_a_cn: 采用常规一年 Cliff 后开始归属，并保留所有旧批次合同
295.option_a_en: Use a standard one-year cliff before vesting begins and honor every legacy grant
295.option_b_cn: 采用两年 Cliff 后加速归属，以更长等待强化金手铐
295.option_b_en: Use a two-year cliff followed by accelerated vesting to strengthen retention

296.option_a_cn: Cliff 后按季度归属，旧批次仍按原合同执行
296.option_a_en: Vest quarterly after the cliff while honoring every legacy schedule
296.option_b_cn: 统一年度集中归属，以低账务成本换取归属日断崖
296.option_b_en: Use one annual vesting date to cut administration despite a sharp departure cliff

297.option_a_cn: 每批写明服务与绩效归属占比，用冻结条件分别结算
297.option_a_en: State service and performance vesting shares per grant and settle each frozen condition separately
297.option_b_cn: 一次 3.25 即取消全部未归属份额，不再区分留任部分
297.option_b_en: Cancel every unvested unit after one 3.25 without preserving the service portion

298.option_a_cn: 组织未达标时按完成比例缩减，再独立判断个人门槛
298.option_a_en: Scale awards to organizational completion, then judge the individual gate separately
298.option_b_cn: 组织门槛未过即全员归零，以共同风险强压结果
298.option_b_en: Void every award when the organization misses its gate, enforcing shared outcome risk

299.option_a_cn: 按裁撤、调动、退休、跳槽与舞弊的冻结事实分别处理权益
299.option_a_en: Settle rights by frozen facts for redundancy, transfer, retirement, resignation, and fraud
299.option_b_cn: 将所有主动离任归为 Bad Leaver，统一没收未归属权益
299.option_b_en: Classify every voluntary exit as bad leaver and forfeit all unvested rights

300.option_a_cn: 按国库预算定期开窗，公开离任优先与申请队列并逐笔支付
300.option_a_en: Open budgeted buybacks periodically with published leaver priority and an application queue
300.option_b_cn: 关闭固定窗口，只为关键人才临时插队变现
300.option_b_en: Close regular windows and grant ad hoc liquidity only to critical talent

301.option_a_cn: 拆分战略顺风、资源倾斜与个人增量，只按证据小幅校正
301.option_a_en: Separate strategic tailwind, resource advantage, and individual increment, adjusting only with evidence
301.option_b_cn: 按绝对规模直接排名，让核心团队以大盘结果优先拿高档
301.option_b_en: Rank absolute scale directly so core teams receive top ratings from headline results

302.option_a_cn: 以守住跌幅、主动收缩和第二曲线里程碑评价逆风贡献
302.option_a_en: Assess headwind work through contained decline, managed contraction, and second-curve milestones
302.option_b_cn: 继续下达统一增长硬指标，以末位压力淘汰未增长者
302.option_b_en: Keep one hard growth target and use bottom-rating pressure on anyone who misses it

303.option_a_cn: 保护一至两轮，按学习、试点和里程碑考核，到期毕业、转向或关闭
303.option_a_en: Protect one or two cycles, score learning and pilots, then graduate, pivot, or close
303.option_b_cn: 新业务立即与成熟现金牛比较绝对产出，快速筛掉弱项目
303.option_b_en: Compare new ventures immediately with mature cash cows and cut weak projects quickly

304.option_a_cn: 冻结项目交付分、职能成长分权重与最终主责，冲突联合校准
304.option_a_en: Freeze project-delivery and functional-growth weights with one final owner and joint calibration
304.option_b_cn: 两位经理各下满额目标，项目 owner 在冲突时直接拍板
304.option_b_en: Let both managers assign full targets and give the project owner unilateral tie-breaking power

305.option_a_cn: 截止日前禁止无危机重组，特批须上级承接名单并冻结旧 cohort
305.option_a_en: Ban non-crisis reorgs before cutoff; require superior ownership and freeze the old cohort
305.option_b_cn: 允许校准前快速换组与汇报线，以重新分配配额压力
305.option_b_en: Allow last-minute team and reporting-line moves to redistribute quota pressure

306.title_en: Capacity Split for a Double-Hatted Acting Lead
306.option_a_cn: 冻结 50/50 或 70/30 容量，配津贴、减目标或代理副手并设到期日
306.option_a_en: Freeze a 50/50 or 70/30 split, add pay, relief, or a deputy, and set an expiry
306.option_b_cn: 一人同时承担两组满额目标，以临时负责人名义强行保运转
306.option_b_en: Assign two full workloads to one acting lead to keep both teams running

307.option_a_cn: 收益团队看收益质量，共享团队看节省、稳定和内部采用并分别答辩
307.option_a_en: Score revenue teams on quality-adjusted return and shared teams on savings, stability, and adoption
307.option_b_cn: 所有团队统一按直接国库产出排名，快速压缩低收益部门
307.option_b_en: Rank every team by direct treasury output and rapidly cut low-revenue units

308.option_a_cn: 按管理幅度、审批等待和评分误差增减中层与一线专家
308.option_a_en: Adjust managers and specialists using span, approval delay, and rating-error evidence
308.option_b_cn: 立即扁平化压缩管理 HC，以更少层级换取短期成本下降
308.option_b_en: Flatten immediately and cut management HC for near-term savings with fewer layers

309.option_a_cn: 安排轮值述职与上司巡访，并从经理容量中扣除真实曝光成本
309.option_a_en: Rotate reviews and manager visits, charging the real visibility cost to management capacity
309.option_b_cn: 继续只收远程材料，让京城关系与自我宣传决定可见度
309.option_b_en: Rely on remote reports and let capital relationships and self-promotion determine visibility

310.title_en: Mapping Legacy Ratings into a Merged Team
310.option_a_cn: 保留旧制原值与映射说明，经一轮共同基线后再纳入新配额
310.option_a_en: Preserve original ratings and mappings, then enter new quotas after one common baseline cycle
310.option_b_cn: 立即按简单等值表折算并投入新组校准，快速统一尺度
310.option_b_en: Convert immediately through a simple equivalence table and calibrate in the new team

311.title_en: No Retroactive Rewrite After a Strategic Pivot
311.option_a_cn: 按旧批准目标结算已完成部分，从变更日另立新责任书
311.option_a_en: Settle completed work against the approved old goal and open a new charter on the change date
311.option_b_cn: 用新战略倒改整轮目标，统一按最新方向追究结果
311.option_b_en: Rewrite the entire cycle to the new strategy and judge all results by the latest direction

312.option_a_cn: 所有合资格者可见空岗、汇报线、薪酬带和目标，内部期后再外招
312.option_a_en: Publish openings, reporting lines, bands, and goals to all eligible staff before external hiring
312.option_b_cn: 空岗只在经理圈流转，由熟悉的人选快速补位
312.option_b_en: Circulate openings only among managers and fill quickly through familiar candidates

313.title_en: Standardized Reference from the Former Manager
313.option_a_cn: 按成果、风险、PIP 与交接写结构化事实，拒绝推荐也须可复核
313.option_a_en: Provide structured facts on results, risk, PIP, and handover, with reviewable refusal reasons
313.option_b_cn: 允许原经理私下电话定性，以软评价快速阻止高风险转岗
313.option_b_en: Let the former manager privately characterize the candidate to block risky transfers quickly

314.option_a_cn: 按距离与家庭负担给一次金币、限期津贴或安置，并由本人接受
314.option_a_en: Offer distance- and family-based cash, dated allowance, or support subject to employee consent
314.option_b_cn: 把跨地域调任视为任命义务，不给补助并限期到岗
314.option_b_en: Treat relocation as an appointment duty, provide no support, and enforce a reporting date

315.option_a_cn: 先短期试岗，冻结双线分功和三方退出条件，失败可返岗
315.option_a_en: Run a short trial with dual credit and three-party exit terms, including return rights
315.option_b_cn: 直接永久转任并立即切断原岗，以强承诺加速融入
315.option_b_en: Transfer permanently and sever the old role immediately to force rapid commitment

316.option_a_cn: 专业薪级与岗位津贴分开，保薪或分期调整并在申请前公开
316.option_a_en: Separate professional pay from role premium and publish preservation or phased adjustment upfront
316.option_b_cn: 到岗即按新岗位带宽重定全部薪俸，消除过渡例外
316.option_b_en: Reset all pay to the new role band on arrival and eliminate transition exceptions

317.option_a_cn: 初筛仅通知本人，终面才告原经理，泄露降评进入反报复审计
317.option_a_en: Keep screening private, notify the manager at finals, and audit retaliatory leaks or ratings
317.option_b_cn: 申请一提交就全程公开，让原经理立即安排资源与留人
317.option_b_en: Disclose every application immediately so the manager can plan capacity and retention

318.title_en: Transfer Application Frequency and Slot Cost
318.option_a_cn: 每轮有限正式申请，另给高潜一次不占槽的探索面谈并约束拖延
318.option_a_en: Limit formal applications, add one no-slot exploration for high potential, and police delay
318.option_b_cn: 每轮只准一次正式申请，错过或撤回即封闭本轮流动
318.option_b_en: Allow only one formal application per cycle; withdrawal or failure closes mobility

319.option_a_cn: 原团队仅可给一次可交付方案，本人拒绝后按冻结时限交接放人
319.option_a_en: Permit one deliverable counteroffer, then require a timed handover after rejection
319.option_b_cn: 允许原经理连续加码并延迟交接，直到关键工作补齐
319.option_b_en: Allow repeated counteroffers and delayed release until critical work is backfilled

320.option_a_cn: 允许实名、匿名或不答，按经理和制度聚合重复信号后触发审计
320.option_a_en: Allow named, anonymous, or no response and audit repeated manager or policy patterns
320.option_b_cn: 将实名反馈直接交原经理处置，并逐案归类为文化不适应
320.option_b_en: Send named feedback directly to the former manager and classify each exit as culture mismatch

321.option_a_cn: 保留正常离任者为可联系校友，维护关键技能、回聘与推荐关系
321.option_a_en: Keep healthy leavers as contactable alumni for critical skills, rehiring, and referrals
321.option_b_cn: 离任即完全断联，以零维护成本保护内部信息
321.option_b_en: Cut all ties on exit to eliminate maintenance cost and protect internal information

322.title_en: Old Record and New Evidence for Returning Talent
322.option_a_cn: 保留旧案卷与离职原因，加入外部成长后针对差距重审
322.option_a_en: Preserve the old dossier and exit cause, add external growth, and reassess identified gaps
322.option_b_cn: 回流即清空旧账，以当前急缺和外部头衔快速录用
322.option_b_en: Wipe the old record on return and hire quickly from current need and external title

323.option_a_cn: 按能力缺口、岗位杠杆与应用任务组合投向补弱、高潜和经理训练
323.option_a_en: Portfolio the budget by skill gap, role leverage, and application tasks across key groups
323.option_b_cn: 把预算集中给本轮高绩效者，以最短时间扩大可见产出
323.option_b_en: Concentrate learning spend on current top performers for the fastest visible output

324.title_en: Course, Application, and Business Result Stages
324.option_a_cn: 结课只记学习，应用真实任务后再按业务改善兑现绩效
324.option_a_en: Record completion as learning only, then award performance after real application and results
324.option_b_cn: 以结课和证书数量直接计绩效，快速鼓励全员参训
324.option_b_en: Count course completions and certificates directly as performance to drive rapid participation

325.title_en: Certificate KPI and Practical Skill Checks
325.option_a_cn: 证书结合实操抽测，已有成果可免测并校验题目是否失真
325.option_a_en: Combine certificates with practical checks, waive proven performers, and validate the test
325.option_b_cn: 设置证书数量硬门槛，以统一凭证快速筛选能力
325.option_b_en: Use a hard certificate-count gate to screen capability quickly with one credential

326.option_a_cn: 参会须带回可复用知识并被团队采用，才兑现组织贡献
326.option_a_en: Require reusable knowledge to return and be adopted before awarding organizational credit
326.option_b_cn: 优先派明星对外露脸，以专业声誉和招募曝光换当期交付时间
326.option_b_en: Send star performers for external visibility, trading delivery time for brand and recruiting reach

327.option_a_cn: 记录后续应用并从讲师目标中折算授课工时，按真实影响计功
327.option_a_en: Track downstream use, deduct teaching hours from targets, and credit demonstrated impact
327.option_b_cn: 按听课人数和课次直接计功，用大课迅速扩大可见度
327.option_b_en: Credit attendance and lecture count directly, using large classes for rapid visibility

328.option_a_cn: 预留跨组工时维护标准、案例和评审，并把成果带回原团队
328.option_a_en: Reserve cross-team time for standards, cases, and reviews with explicit local return
328.option_b_cn: 经理限制共同体参与，要求所有容量优先本组短期项目
328.option_b_en: Restrict community work and reserve all capacity for the manager's near-term projects

329.option_a_cn: 跨团队匹配有目标的导师，由受益组支付时间且冲突可换一次
329.option_a_en: Match a goal-bound external mentor, charge the beneficiary team, and allow one conflict switch
329.option_b_cn: 导师资源只留本组，由直属经理指定最方便的人选
329.option_b_en: Keep mentoring inside the team and let the line manager assign the most convenient person

330.option_a_cn: 给受保护时间和阶段任务转训到增长岗，按真实应用决定转入
330.option_a_en: Fund protected time and staged tasks toward growth roles, transferring on demonstrated application
330.option_b_cn: 直接外招成熟技能并让旧岗位人员退出，以最快补齐能力
330.option_b_en: Hire ready-made skills externally and exit legacy staff to close the gap fastest

331.option_a_cn: 每轮冻结少量学习容量，真危机挪用须写明补回日期
331.option_a_en: Reserve a small learning capacity each cycle and date any emergency payback
331.option_b_cn: 学习只准放在项目空档，交付吃紧时可永久取消
331.option_b_en: Allow learning only between projects and cancel it whenever delivery tightens

332.option_a_cn: 让继任候选定期独立主持安全演练，现任仅保留紧急否决权
332.option_a_en: Let succession candidates lead safe rehearsals while incumbents retain only emergency veto
332.option_b_cn: 不做演练，岗位突缺时直接按继任名单任命第一人
332.option_b_en: Skip rehearsal and appoint the first listed successor when the role suddenly opens

333.option_a_cn: 按月递减培训返还义务，组织裁撤豁免并以真实应用验收收益
333.option_a_en: Taper repayment monthly, waive organization-led exits, and validate benefit through application
333.option_b_cn: 培训后离任一律全额追索，以硬绑定保护投入
333.option_b_en: Claw back the full training cost after any departure to protect the investment

334.title_en: Unified Demand Intake with Source Labels
334.option_a_cn: 所有需求标来源进入统一队列，被拒事项也保留价值 owner
334.option_a_en: Route every sourced request through one queue and retain value ownership even when rejected
334.option_b_cn: 允许高权 sponsor 私聊插单，以关系优先迅速启动事项
334.option_b_en: Allow powerful sponsors to insert private requests and start work immediately

335.option_a_cn: 预留少量急件槽，超额须延旧目标、补资源或由插单者签取舍
335.option_a_en: Reserve a few urgent slots; excess requests must trade scope, resources, or signed ownership
335.option_b_cn: 紧急需求可随时挤掉原目标，以即时响应优先处理年底债务
335.option_b_en: Let urgent work displace committed goals at any time and handle the debt later

336.title_en: Definition of Ready for Demand Admission
336.option_a_cn: 缺受益人、验收、边界或依赖时退回补充，或只批小额探索
336.option_a_en: Return requests missing beneficiary, acceptance, scope, or dependencies, or fund discovery only
336.option_b_cn: 高层可将模糊需求直接压成正式承诺，用执行团队边做边澄清
336.option_b_en: Let senior leaders force vague requests into commitments and clarify during execution

337.option_a_cn: 冻结后改范围须延时、删等量事项、加预算或承认原需求失误
337.option_a_en: After freeze, pay for scope change with time, equal cuts, budget, or acknowledged error
337.option_b_cn: 领导可随时改需求且保持原期限，把返工压力留给执行者
337.option_b_en: Let leaders change requirements without moving the deadline, leaving rework to executors

338.option_a_cn: 冲突时由批准人签字选择砍范围、延期限、补 HC 或降质量
338.option_a_en: When constraints conflict, make the approver sign a scope, time, HC, or quality tradeoff
338.option_b_cn: 范围期限都不动，默认执行团队压缩质量以保表面承诺
338.option_b_en: Hold scope and date fixed and make the delivery team silently compress quality

339.title_en: Estimate Calibration Instead of On-Time Rewards
339.option_a_cn: 分解复杂度误判、故意留水和外部阻塞，按逐轮变准奖励估算
339.option_a_en: Separate complexity error, padding, and blockers, rewarding estimates that improve over cycles
339.option_b_cn: 只奖是否准时，鼓励所有人报足缓冲以保证兑现
339.option_b_en: Reward on-time delivery alone, encouraging enough padding to guarantee the date

340.option_a_cn: 每人只承诺少量在制项目，临时超限须审批并记录容量代价
340.option_a_en: Limit concurrent commitments per person and approve temporary excess with capacity cost
340.option_b_cn: 允许多项目并开，以可见忙碌和抢先启动换取交付尾差
340.option_b_en: Open many projects at once, trading completion for visible activity and early starts

341.option_a_cn: 原样结转、拆小重估或诚实取消，保留已验收部分并占下轮容量
341.option_a_en: Carry, resize, or cancel honestly, preserving accepted work and consuming next-cycle capacity
341.option_b_cn: 把未完事项改名“第一期完成”，立即关单并在下轮重新立项
341.option_b_en: Rename unfinished work phase one complete, close it now, and reopen next cycle

342.option_a_cn: 记录等待对象、起点和升级动作，长期不升级者承担部分责任
342.option_a_en: Record the blocker, start time, and escalation; assign partial liability when the owner lets a block persist without escalating
342.option_b_cn: 不单列阻塞时间，最终延期统一由项目 owner 承担
342.option_b_en: Do not track blocked time and charge every final delay to the project owner

343.option_a_cn: 提出者签范围、执行者交付、受益方验收，退回和变更各有 owner
343.option_a_en: Have requester sign scope, executor deliver, and beneficiary accept, with owners for rejection and change
343.option_b_cn: 执行者完成动作即可自报关单，受益方异议留到绩效后处理
343.option_b_en: Let executors close on completed activity and defer beneficiary objections until after review

344.option_a_cn: 上线只发有限分，采用与价值验证后用同一项目 ID 兑现余奖
344.option_a_en: Award limited credit at launch and settle adoption and value later under one project ID
344.option_b_cn: 项目一上线即发全额功劳和奖金，后续运营另行考核
344.option_b_en: Pay all credit and bonus at launch and assess later operations separately

345.title_en: Annual, Semiannual, or Quarterly Review Cycle
345.option_a_cn: 采用年度终评加一次期中轻检查，以长期结果控制事件负担
345.option_a_en: Use one annual review plus a light midyear check to preserve long outcomes and control load
345.option_b_cn: 每季度完整重跑考核与校准，以高频压力换快速纠偏
345.option_b_en: Rerun full review and calibration quarterly for rapid correction under constant pressure

346.title_en: Material Performance Signals Outside the Cycle
346.option_a_cn: 重大功过即时记一次性信号，只调奖励、调查或目标，年末消费一次
346.option_a_en: Record a one-use off-cycle signal for reward, inquiry, or goal change and consume it once
346.option_b_cn: 重大事件立即重跑整组排名，以最快反映最新表现
346.option_b_en: Rerun the whole cohort immediately after a major event to reflect the latest performance

347.option_a_cn: 每位经理仅有少量调整点，点名受益者、承担者、理由并回写命中率
347.option_a_en: Give managers few override points naming beneficiary, bearer, reason, and later accuracy
347.option_b_cn: 允许经理按整体判断自由改榜，以快速纠正算法不懂的人情
347.option_b_en: Let managers freely rewrite rankings to correct algorithmic blind spots immediately

348.option_a_cn: 保护、津贴、HC、豁免和权限均设到期日，续期必须提交新事实
348.option_a_en: Sunset protections, premiums, HC, exemptions, and access; require new facts for renewal
348.option_b_cn: 一次特批默认永久沿用，减少反复审批与人员不安
348.option_b_en: Grandfather every exception permanently to avoid repeated approval and uncertainty

349.option_a_cn: 随机抽样结合高风险定向审查，透明团队可换较低抽查率
349.option_a_en: Combine random samples with risk-targeted audits and discount transparent teams
349.option_b_cn: 维持极低抽查但查实即重罚，以小成本制造高威慑
349.option_b_en: Keep audit rates very low but punish findings severely for cheap deterrence

350.option_a_cn: 比较跨年 KPI、档位与兑现，只为新轮更新标杆并解释战略难度
350.option_a_en: Compare historical KPI, ratings, and outcomes and update only future benchmarks with context
350.option_b_cn: 发现高档增多就自动抬高全员门槛，迅速压回原分布
350.option_b_en: Raise everyone's bar automatically when top ratings grow to restore the distribution quickly

351.option_a_cn: 少数公爵领预注册规则、对照组和结束日，再按冻结结果扩张
351.option_a_en: Preregister rules, controls, and end dates in a few duchies before evidence-based expansion
351.option_b_cn: 全境立即切换新规则，以统一执行快速获得大样本
351.option_b_en: Switch the whole realm immediately for uniform enforcement and a large sample

352.title_en: Mapping Legacy Records Across Policy Versions
352.option_a_cn: 保留旧制原值并附可比映射，或从新轮另起序列
352.option_a_en: Preserve legacy values with a comparison mapping or start a separate new sequence
352.option_b_cn: 按最新公式静默重算全部历史，使报表立即统一
352.option_b_en: Silently recompute all history under the latest formula for instant uniformity

353.title_en: Performance Administration Cost in Manager Reports
353.option_a_cn: 统计填表、会议、申诉和打断工时，删低价值环节并跟踪错误反弹
353.option_a_en: Measure forms, meetings, appeals, and interruptions; remove low-value steps and track errors
353.option_b_cn: 继续加码流程控制但不计行政工时，以合规优先压住风险
353.option_b_en: Add controls without measuring administration, prioritizing compliance over capacity

354.option_a_cn: 元审计抽查原始申诉、流失与退出事实，奖励主动暴露并修复问题
354.option_a_en: Meta-audit raw appeals, attrition, and exits, rewarding disclosure and repair
354.option_b_cn: 把低翻案率和低流失设硬指标，要求经理迅速压平坏数据
354.option_b_en: Set low overturn and attrition rates as hard targets and make managers flatten bad data

355.option_a_cn: 区分可复制能力与偶然红利，限制目标增幅并同步资源或权力
355.option_a_en: Separate repeatable ability from windfall, cap target growth, and add resources or authority
355.option_b_cn: 以上轮峰值直接设新底线，以持续加压榨取更高产出
355.option_b_en: Make last cycle's peak the new floor and keep pressure rising for more output

356.option_a_cn: 按真实完成时点核对成果并限制目标棘轮，鼓励立即上报
356.option_a_en: Audit actual completion timestamps and restrain ratchets so full results are reported promptly
356.option_b_cn: 只按截止日入账并持续抬目标，让官员自行平滑两轮产出
356.option_b_en: Book only at cutoff and keep ratcheting targets, leaving officials to smooth output

357.title_en: Lock Facts Before Applying the 361 Quota
357.option_a_cn: 先冻结绝对表现与证据，再单独执行相对分布并标明配额降档
357.option_a_en: Freeze absolute performance and evidence first, then apply relative quotas and label downgrades
357.option_b_cn: 一次校准会直接定档，再倒推理由填满强制分布
357.option_b_en: Set ratings in one calibration meeting and backfill reasons to satisfy the quota

358.option_a_cn: 原申诉只能维持或减轻，新造假必须另立案、重新举证送达
358.option_a_en: An appeal may only hold or reduce; open a separately noticed case for newly discovered fraud
358.option_b_cn: 复核时可一并加重处罚，以阻止无根据申诉占用资源
358.option_b_en: Allow reviewers to increase penalties in the same appeal to deter weak filings

359.title_en: Quota Reflow and Renotice After an Overturn
359.option_a_cn: 使用预留名额或重审边界人，凡受影响者均重新送达并允许申诉
359.option_a_en: Use reserve quota or review boundary cases, renotifying every affected official with appeal rights
359.option_b_cn: 暗中把边界人降档以立即补回配额，不重开连环程序
359.option_b_en: Quietly downgrade a boundary case to restore quota without reopening the chain

360.title_en: Collective Manager Refusal to Force a C
360.option_a_cn: 经理联合申请有证据的例外或公开改革，并承担管理分代价
360.option_a_en: Let managers jointly seek an evidenced exception or public reform at a management-score cost
360.option_b_cn: 命令各经理单独硬切末位，以组织强制力守住人才密度叙事
360.option_b_en: Order each manager to force a bottom rating and preserve the talent-density narrative

361.option_a_cn: 锁定证据公平、长期创新与组织温度优先的可修订宪章，并持续十年审计
361.option_a_en: Adopt a revisable charter prioritizing evidence, long-term innovation, and organizational health with ten-year audits
361.option_b_cn: 锁定强制竞争与即时交付优先的硬宪章，用高压换人才密度
361.option_b_en: Adopt a hard charter prioritizing forced competition and immediate delivery for talent density
